layers.name: primitive
layers.purpose: Raw color, typography, spacing, radius, stroke, shadow, frame values from Figma and local reference screenshots.

layers.name: semantic
layers.purpose: Purpose aliases for stage, surface, text, line, status, and deck role usage.

layers.name: typography
layers.purpose: Text role specs with Figma source values, fallback policy, and rebuild constraints.

layers.name: fontAsset
layers.purpose: Font provenance, local files, hashes, Figma availability, and missing-font risk per deck font.

layers.name: effects
layers.purpose: Gradients, overlays, masks, image treatments, strokes, and glow recipes.

layers.name: surface
layers.purpose: Glass, stage, panel, table, and image-mask surface recipes that combine fill, opacity, blur, border, and blend mode.

layers.name: component
layers.purpose: Component-level tokens for deck frames, headers, flow nodes, dark tables, and scenario cards.

layers.name: slide
layers.purpose: Slide-specific layout zones, anchors, source node mapping, and composition contracts.

layers.name: asset
layers.purpose: Image/raster/editable boundaries, crop policies, source paths, and Figma image-fill node mapping.

layers.name: qa
layers.purpose: Machine-readable gates for rebuild QA, visual diff, and editable-layer checks.

layers.name: assetizationBacklog
layers.purpose: Machine-readable slide-level extraction, component-promotion, token-family, and QA backlog for all 14 slides.

layers.name: figma
layers.purpose: Figma variable/style/component mapping for A5 Builder.
